name: openpalm
description: Connect Claude Desktop to a local OpenPalm Guardian.
long_description: A local, transparent MCP bridge to an operator-managed OpenPalm Guardian. Guardian remains responsible for authentication, policy, moderation, workspace access, and audit logging.

guardian_url.title: Guardian MCP URL
guardian_url.description: Loopback URL for the local OpenPalm Guardian MCP endpoint.

credential_key.title: OpenPalm credential key
credential_key.description: Bearer key for a named OpenPalm credential. Its configured policy controls available capabilities.
